name: @manorg/contracts
description: OpenAPI 3.1 contract (single source of truth) and the types generated from it.

scripts.check: openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o src/schema.d.ts.tmp >/dev/null && cmp -s src/schema.d.ts src/schema.d.ts.tmp; s=$?; rm -f src/schema.d.ts.tmp; [ $s -eq 0 ] || echo "src/schema.d.ts is stale: run pnpm contracts:gen"; exit $s
